```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load Libraries
```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(tidyverse)
library(ranger)
library(xgboost)
library(kernlab)
library(vip)
library(doParallel)
```

# Recipe
```{r}
VI_recipe_corr_pca <- recipe(Yield_avg ~ ., data = train_vi) %>%
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) %>%
  step_corr(all_numeric_predictors(), threshold = 0.90) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |> 
  step_pca(
    all_numeric_predictors(),
    threshold = 0.99
  )
```

# Model specifications
```{r}
VI_rf_spec <- rand_forest(
  mtry  = tune(),
  trees = 1000,
  min_n = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation") %>%
  set_mode("regression")
```

# Workflows
```{r}
VI_rf_wf <- workflow() %>%
  add_recipe(VI_recipe_corr_pca) %>%
  add_model(VI_rf_spec)
```

## Parallel processing
```{r}
cl <- makePSOCKcluster(parallel::detectCores() - 1)
registerDoParallel(cl)
```

### Tuning grids
```{r}
set.seed(123)

VI_rf_grid <- grid_regular(
  mtry(range = c(2, 8)),
  min_n(range = c(2, 25)),
  levels = 6
)
```

# Tune models
```{r}
VI_metrics_used <- yardstick::metric_set(
  yardstick::rmse,
  yardstick::rsq,
  yardstick::mae
)

VI_rf_tune <- tune_grid(
  VI_rf_wf,
  resamples = cv_folds_vi,
  grid = VI_rf_grid,
  metrics = VI_metrics_used
)
stopCluster(cl)
```

# Best models based on RMSE
```{r}
VI_best_rf  <- select_best(VI_rf_tune, metric = "rmse")
VI_best_rf
```

# Finalize workflows
```{r}
VI_final_rf_wf  <- finalize_workflow(VI_rf_wf, VI_best_rf)
```

# Fit final models on training data and evaluate on test data
```{r}
data_split <- make_splits(train_vi, test_vi)

VI_rf_final <- last_fit(
  VI_final_rf_wf, data_split, metrics = VI_metrics_used
)
```

# Compare performance
```{r}
model_results_VI <- collect_metrics(VI_rf_final)  %>% mutate(model = "Random Forest")%>%
  dplyr::select(model, .metric, .estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = .estimate)

model_results_VI
```

# Get predictions
```{r}
VI_rf_pred <- collect_predictions(VI_rf_final) %>%
  mutate(model = "Random Forest")

VI_all_predictions <- VI_rf_pred
```

# Observed vs predicted plot
```{r}
# Fit finalized RF workflow on training data only
VI_rf_fit_train <- fit(VI_final_rf_wf, data = train_vi)

# Training, internal testing and 2024 validation predictions
all_predictions_VI <- bind_rows(
  # Training: 80% of sampled 2019–2023 observations
  predict(VI_rf_fit_train, new_data = train_vi) %>%
    bind_cols(train_vi) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Training", model = "Random Forest"),

  # Internal testing: remaining 20%
  predict(VI_rf_fit_train, new_data = test_vi) %>%
    bind_cols(test_vi) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Testing", model = "Random Forest"),

  # Temporal validation: 2024
  predict(VI_rf_fit_train, new_data = validation_vi) %>%
    bind_cols(validation_vi) %>%
    mutate(dataset = "Validation (2024)", model = "Random Forest")
) %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(
      dataset,
      levels = c("Training", "Testing", "Validation (2024)")
    ),
    model = factor(model, levels = "Random Forest")
  )

# Metrics for each dataset
VI_metrics_plot <- all_predictions_VI %>%
  group_by(dataset, model) %>%
  summarise(
    R2   = yardstick::rsq_vec(Yield_avg, .pred),
    RMSE = yardstick::rmse_vec(Yield_avg, .pred),
    MAE  = yardstick::mae_vec(Yield_avg, .pred),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = sprintf(
      "R² = %.2f\nRMSE = %.2f\nMAE = %.2f",
      R2, RMSE, MAE
    ),
    x = Inf,
    y = -Inf
  )
print(VI_metrics_plot)
```

```{r}
dataset_levels <- c("Training", "Testing", "Validation (2024)")

VI_pred <- all_predictions_VI %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_levels)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Yield_avg, .pred)) +
  geom_point(
    colour = "#009E73",
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ x,
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    fullrange = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    intercept = 0,
    slope = 1,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = VI_metrics_plot %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = factor(dataset, levels = dataset_levels)
      ),
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = -0.1,
    size = 4
  ) +
  facet_grid(
    dataset ~ model,
    scales = "fixed",
    labeller = labeller(
      dataset = c(
        "Training" = "Training",
        "Testing" = "Internal testing",
        "Validation (2024)" = "Validation (2024)"
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Observed yield" ~ (bu ~ ac^{-1})),
    y = expression("Predicted yield" ~ (bu ~ ac^{-1})),
    title = "(A) Vegetation indices"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14)
  )

VI_pred
ggsave("Figures/Figures_04/VI_pred_corr_pca.png", width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

# Metrics table
```{r}
# VI metrics: RF only
metrics_table_VI <- all_predictions_VI %>%
  filter(model == "Random Forest") %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = factor(
      dataset,
      levels = c("Training", "Testing", "Validation (2024)")
    ),
    model = factor(model, levels = "Random Forest")
  ) %>%
  group_by(dataset, model) %>%
  summarise(
    n    = n(),
    R2   = yardstick::rsq_vec(truth = Yield_avg, estimate = .pred),
    RMSE = yardstick::rmse_vec(truth = Yield_avg, estimate = .pred),
    MAE  = yardstick::mae_vec(truth = Yield_avg, estimate = .pred),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(dataset) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(R2, RMSE, MAE), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

metrics_table_VI
```

# Variable importance for Random Forest
```{r}
rf_fit_VI <- extract_workflow(VI_rf_final) %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip()

vip(rf_fit_VI, num_features = 15,
    aesthetics = list(fill = "midnightblue",
                      colour = "midnightblue")) +
  labs(title = "(A) Vegetation Indices") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )
ggsave("Figures/Figures_04/VI_VarImp_corr_pca.png", width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```
